mood.en: The quiet resilience of everyday life.

concept.zh: 一条小路，通往黄土坡上的一孔窑洞。用大地的弧线承载生活的重量，把希望留给那道门。
concept.en: A narrow path climbs a loess hillside toward a cave dwelling. The earth carries the weight of daily life; a small doorway leaves room for hope.

restraint.zh: 没有人物肖像，也没有乡村元素的堆叠。
restraint.en: No portraits or catalogue of rural objects.

alt.zh: 赭色黄土坡、蜿蜒的白色小路和深蓝色窑洞入口。
alt.en: Ochre loess terraces, a winding ivory path and a dark blue cave doorway.

mood.zh: 孤绝之中，仍有一个出口。
mood.en: Isolation, with the possibility of escape.

concept.zh: 深蓝海水环绕一座孤岛。城堡只留一扇暖色的窗，海面的弧线让禁锢与自由同时存在。
concept.en: Dark water encircles an island fortress. One warm opening interrupts its silence; the curve of the sea holds confinement and freedom together.

restraint.zh: 舍去剑、锁链和王冠，让空间讲故事。
restraint.en: Swords, chains and crowns give way to a spatial story.

alt.zh: 深蓝色海水环绕孤岛城堡，窗内透出一点赭色光。
alt.en: An island fortress surrounded by ink-blue sea, with a small ochre-lit window.

concept.zh: 小路在水边停下，渡船停在两岸之间。斜斜的渡绳让画面有了牵挂，空出的河面留下等待的时间。
concept.en: A path stops at the water. A ferry waits between two banks. Its diagonal rope creates a delicate connection across an otherwise empty river.

restraint.zh: 不画翠翠的肖像，也不把风景画满。
restraint.en: No portrait of Cuicui; the landscape stays open.

alt.zh: 蓝色河流穿过赭色河岸，一条细绳牵着无人的渡船。
alt.en: A blue river between ochre banks, with an empty ferry on a slender crossing rope.

author.zh: 尼古拉·奥斯特洛夫斯基

concept.zh: 铁轨向雪地尽头收束。纸的本色成为积雪，一线铜色停在消失点，把艰难与继续前行放进同一幅画。
concept.en: Railway tracks converge through a snowy landscape. Unprinted paper becomes snow; a small copper glint at the vanishing point suggests continued effort.

restraint.zh: 不靠口号、旗帜或工业全景表达力量。
restraint.en: Resolve without slogans, flags or an industrial panorama.

alt.zh: 两条铁轨穿过灰蓝色雪地，延伸向远方一点铜色光。
alt.en: Two railway tracks converge through slate-blue snowbanks toward a small copper clearing.

title.en: White Horse Neighs in the West Wind

mood.en: An open landscape, a private solitude.

concept.zh: 一匹白马经过低低的沙丘，身后的细小足迹渐渐远去。把马画小，风和距离就有了位置。
concept.en: A small ivory horse crosses a low dune, leaving a delicate trail. Its modest scale lets wind and distance carry the emotion.

restraint.zh: 白马属于沙漠，不把它画成徽章。
restraint.en: The horse belongs to the desert, rather than becoming a crest.

alt.zh: 一匹小小的白马经过赭色沙丘，留下细细的足迹。
alt.en: A small white horse crosses an ochre dune, leaving a fine trail.

title.en: The Old Man and the Sea

mood.en: A small boat, an unbroken resolve.

concept.zh: 让海面占据整个画面的重量，小船只留一点。钓线向深处延伸，力量藏在比例之中。
concept.en: The sea carries almost all the visual weight. A small skiff and a fine descending line let scale express persistence.

restraint.zh: 不画巨大的鱼，不把故事变成捕鱼图解。
restraint.en: No oversized fish or diagram of fishing gear.

alt.zh: 深蓝色海面上的一叶小舟，细细的钓线沉入水中。
alt.en: A tiny ivory skiff on a broad blue sea, with a fine line descending into the water.

revision.reason: Clear an author margin while preserving the illustration.

concept.zh: 两重空庭，一道月门，几片落花。用褪去的胭脂色与没有人的空间，留下盛衰之后的回声。
concept.en: An empty courtyard opens into another through a moon gate. A few fallen petals and faded rose ink suggest the echo of a vanished season.

restraint.zh: 舍去繁复服饰与人物群像，保留一处空庭。
restraint.en: An empty courtyard takes the place of elaborate costumes and a cast of characters.

alt.zh: 褪红色庭墙与月门，纸白色地面上落着几片花瓣。
alt.en: A faded rose courtyard wall and moon gate, with a few petals on an ivory floor.

mood.zh: 在自己家里，成为局外人。

concept.zh: 一扇关着的门，门外一片无法归属的阴影。把昆虫从画面里拿走，陌生感便留在房间本身。
concept.en: A closed door and an unclaimed shadow occupy an austere room. Removing the insect lets the room itself become unfamiliar.

restraint.zh: 不用甲虫剪影解释书名，也不堆叠超现实符号。
restraint.en: No beetle silhouette or surreal collage to spell out the title.

alt.zh: 灰色空房间里，一扇关着的深色门投下长长的阴影。
alt.en: A closed dark door and a long angular shadow in an empty grey room.

revision.reason: Clear an author margin while preserving the illustration.

mood.en: Always moving, with less room ahead.

concept.zh: 高墙把一条小巷越挤越窄。车停在画面的边缘，大块阴影压下来，日常的街道有了生活的阻力。
concept.en: High walls narrow an empty lane. A rickshaw waits at the edge while a broad shadow presses into the street, making ordinary space feel difficult.

restraint.zh: 不画骆驼，避免按书名逐字配物。
restraint.en: No literal camel chosen merely from the Chinese title.

alt.zh: 灰蓝色高墙围住狭窄小巷，一辆空人力车停在左侧。
alt.en: High grey-blue walls compress a narrow lane, with an empty rickshaw at its left edge.

mood.zh: 远处的地方，心里的距离。
mood.en: A distant place, close in the mind.

concept.zh: 灯塔缩到远岸的一点。曲折的白色水道从近处伸向那里，让抵达的愿望占据整片海面。
concept.en: The lighthouse shrinks to a point on a distant headland. A winding ivory channel moves toward it, giving longing the shape of water.

restraint.zh: 不把灯塔放大成地标插画，也不增加装饰光束。
restraint.en: No oversized landmark or decorative beam of light.

alt.zh: 灰蓝潮水之间的白色水道，通向远岸一座极小的灯塔。
alt.en: An ivory channel through slate-blue tidal water leads toward a tiny distant lighthouse.
